model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average values of hidden states in a neural network model across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines representing different hidden state means: the blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before the gate, with an average value of 0.71; the orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after the gate, with an average value of 0.05; and the green solid line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, with an average value of 0.04. The blue dashed line remains relatively flat and close to the baseline mean until around layer 15, where it begins to increase sharply, reaching its peak at layer 20. The orange dotted line remains consistently low across all layers, while the green solid line shows a slight increase but remains below the baseline mean throughout the plot.
